thread.title: Weekend roundup: Netflix and FAANG stocks | A market melt-up | Dividend stocks

author: Philip van Doorn
title: Weekend roundup: Netflix and FAANG stocks | A market melt-up | Dividend stocks
text:
MarketWatch rounded up 10 of its most interesting topics over the past week. 
1. This year could spell trouble for Netflix investors The FAANG stocks — Facebook Inc. FB, -3.99% Apple Inc. AAPL, +0.92% Amazon.com Inc. AMZN, +1.84% Netflix Inc. NFLX, +1.45% and Google holding company Alphabet Inc. GOOG, +1.34% GOOGL, +1.48% —have led the market higher in recent years. But Jeff Reeves warns investors to be careful with Netflix because it lacks many of the others’ advantages . 
2. How to profit from a possible stock-market melt-up There are always people who believe prices are too high and sit on the sidelines as a market rises. But many eventually fear missing out and jump in, which can cause a melt-up that proceeds a significant decline. Bill Miller believes we may soon see a 30% melt-up . 
Also see: How to prepare now for a stock-market melt-up 
The flip side? The man who called a new bull market in 2012 says take your profits now 
3. A quality screen for dividend stocks You may have heard of the Dogs of the Dow strategy, which is simply to purchase the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.80% stocks that have the highest dividend yields. But Mark Hulbert describes a method of screening dividend stocks for quality that has led to better performance . 
4. An opportunity for high income at discounted prices Natural gas pipeline partnerships lost value as the price of oil declined. But low gas prices have led to increased U.S. production and exports, which is good for the pipeline operators over the long term. Mark Grant believes closed-end funds that invest in pipelines are excellent buys for income-seeking investors right now .
Also: U.S. oil companies expected to produce gusher profits — and big gains for investors 
5. A balanced way to generate retirement income Here’s a retirement income strategy that ties your goals into the periodic rebalancing of your investment portfolio .
6. Breaking down the $2 billion ADT IPO Less than a year has passed since Apollo Global Management LLC APO, +0.78% took ADT private, but an initial public offering of shares of the venerable security company has already been announced. Here are five things you need to know about the ADT IPO , including ADT’s creative non-GAAP accounting.
7. Thoughts on the new economy University of Texas economist James Galbraith worries that central bankers are living in the past and don’t realize that heavy reliance on consumer spending is a time bomb for the U.S. economy . 
8. Bitcoin and blockchain You’ve no doubt seen myriad headlines touting the miracle of bitcoin because of its use of blockchain technology. Here’s an explanation of the technology and an analysis of bitcoin’s real value .
9. Extremely cold weather and global warming An atmospheric scientist examines the connection between this year’s extreme cold in the Northeast and the rapid melting of the Arctic ice cover .
10. How badly do you wish to retire at a young age? Chris Mamula considers the retirement planning advice offered by Mr. Money Mustache and concludes you can pull it off without extreme frugality .
